observations: Overall decision: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (null controls pass but CV fails for both KDE and kNN)
Frozen decision_rule: SURVIVES requires (1) all 8 types null pass AND (2) CV <=0.5 for all 8 types at lambda=1 for BOTH measures; else FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING
KDE pooled subsampled BC at lambda=1: 0.0644 vs lambda=0: 0.0023 (t=7.81 p=0.0007) PASS
kNN pooled subsampled BC at lambda=1: 0.0567 vs lambda=0: 0.0017 (t=6.82 p=0.0012) PASS

kNN per-type null at lambda=0: 8/8 pass (max observed 0.020 <= thresholds 0.046-0.053) – contrast with binned TV 4/8 fail

kNN CV at lambda=1 max 0.7550 (type 0) >0.5 – FAIL (7/8 pass, 1/8 fail) – improves over binned TV max 1.59 but still violates threshold
Binned TV replication: PASS (recomputed per-type mean 0.0343 within 0.0003 of parent 0.034; CV max 1.59 replicated)

Primary comparison at lambda=1: KDE mean per-type 0.1827 vs pooled 0.0644 (ratio pooled/per-type 0.35x), kNN mean per-type 0.1382 vs pooled 0.0567 (ratio 0.41x) – per-type > pooled, opposite to binned TV pooled 1.49x > per-type
No pipeline errors; 80,000 transitions (8 lambdas × 2000 × 5 reps), 200 permutations per type, Scott KDE and Kraskov k=5
Exploratory sensitivity (EXPLORATORY per prereg §14): kNN k=3 CV fail max 0.611, kNN k=10 CV pass max 0.470 (8/8), KDE LOOCV CV fail max 0.800 – all null 8/8 pass (see sensitivity_exploratory.json)
validity_notes: Same DGP parameters and seed structure as parent EXP-FRONTIER-34881708619 and EXP-FRONTIER-34794649996 (8 page types, rotation/scaling/translation × low/high noise × centered/shifted, heteroscedastic Gaussian, deterministic block-cycling 250 per type)

Total transitions per lambda: 2000 (250 per type × 8 types), 5 replications per lambda, 8 lambdas = 80,000 transitions; identical subsampling (250 per type deterministic seed+888) then pooled for pooled-sub measures

KDE uses Gaussian kernel with Scott bandwidth (scipy.stats.gaussian_kde bw_method='scott') on continuous 2D [0,1]^2 without binning; per-type and pooled-sub computed separately with N=200 permutations per type/pooled (shuffling action labels within type)

kNN MI uses Kraskov et al. estimator with k=5 via cKDTree + digamma (run_sensitivity.py:86-108) – vectorized, not the simplified neighbor-count in run_execute.py on-disk which uses 0.5 fixed threshold and is NOT spec-compliant; optimized run used Kraskov version as evidenced by execute_log t-tests and threshold magnitudes (see run_sensitivity.py for reference implementation)

Permutation null: N=200 per type/pooled, 95th percentile threshold for null control (spec-compliant); BC divergence = max(0, observed_raw - perm_mean) for reporting; null check uses observed_raw <= threshold_95th (not BC <=0.5)

CV computed on BC divergence across 5 replications per type at lambda=1; threshold 0.5 per frozen decision_rule; KDE max 0.574 (type 4) and kNN max 0.755 (type 0) both exceed, causing FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING even though binned TV max 1.59 is substantially worse
DGP is synthetic 2D [0,1]^2; no inference to real Web DOM transitions warranted (synthetic-to-real gap remains dominant unknown, per handoff do_not_assume)

run_execute.py on-disk contains legacy implementation with fixed 0.5 threshold and simplified kNN (non-Kraskov) that does NOT match frozen spec; this file is preserved as artifact but the CONFIRMATORY result is derived from optimized execution (execute_log.txt) that implements spec-compliant Kraskov/Scott with permutation thresholds – discrepancy noted for audit
Binned TV replication confirms parent: per-type BC mean 0.0343, null 4/8 fail, CV max 1.59 – validates that parent’s sparse-binning failure is reproducible and not pipeline artifact
Positive controls pass for both measures (KDE p 0.0007, kNN p 0.0012), verifying estimators can detect action-conditional structure; failure is specific to per-type stability (CV) not sensitivity

Exploratory sensitivity (k=3, k=10, KDE LOOCV) labeled EXPLORATORY per prereg §14 deviation policy and cannot support confirmatory claims; k=10 CV pass (max 0.470) is hypothesis-generating only, requires new preregistration

All 8 lambdas measured but decision only uses lambda0 null and lambda1 CV/positive; monotonic scaling across lambdas is descriptive (pooled KDE 0.002→0.064, pooled kNN 0.001→0.056) but not part of frozen rule

Sample size 250/type (0.625 expected counts/bin for binned TV) is sparse for binning but KDE/kNN operate on continuous space; still limited to n=250 per type for density estimation – variance remains high causing CV failures even with improved null control
unresolved: Whether kNN with k=10 (CV pass 8/8 max 0.470 in EXPLORATORY) would survive confirmatory preregistration with same 250/type and proper threshold – requires new confirmatory experiment, cannot be claimed from exploratory
Whether per-type CV would pass at larger n (500-2000 per type, 1.25-5.0 expected counts/bin equivalent density for continuous estimators) – orthogonal sample-size question persists
Whether increasing per-type n or switching to k=10 KDE bandwidth would reduce type-0/type-4 heterogeneity driving max CV (type 4 is scaling_high_0.5,0.5; type 0 is rotation_low_0.5,0.5)

Whether pooled vs per-type ordering at equal per-type n is estimator-dependent (binned TV pooled>per-type 1.49x vs KDE/kNN per-type>pooled 0.35-0.41x) and what this implies for product choice of estimator family
Whether KDE LOOCV bandwidth (EXPLORATORY CV max 0.800) vs Scott (0.574) difference is systematic – LOO maximizes likelihood but increases variance on high-noise types

Whether alternative pooled vs per-type comparison at equal TOTAL n (250 pooled vs 250 per-type) or equal density would change ordering – still confounded by 5.0 vs 0.625 effective density for binned, but continuous estimators mitigate binning artifact

Whether any BC magnitude (KDE pooled 0.064, per-type 0.182; kNN pooled 0.056, per-type 0.138) is sufficient for downstream agent exploration utility vs frequency baseline 0.335 – absolute signal remains below baseline for KDE/kNN pooled but per-type exceeds pooled
Whether real Web DOM transitions exhibit action-conditional structure detectable by KDE/kNN at 250/type – all evidence remains synthetic 2D [0,1]^2, no real-data inference justified
